svg.title: Your next move. My little neural net. Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe ML.
svg.desc: Play against a neural network trained through self-play. 132,266 parameters, generation 168. The board replays 17 legal moves from a recorded evaluation against a one-ply greedy policy at 64 simulations per move; the first 4 moves are the fixed opening. Model plays X. Result: X_WIN. Reduced-motion users see the final position.
svg.text: A small model learning a big strategy.
